ConcordanceRule: agreement required between technical replicates

Source: R/AllClasses.R, R/methods.R
ConcordanceRule-class.Rd

An S4 class saying how the technical replicates of a sample must agree for their calls to pass. It is held in the replicateConc slot of an ISNVFilter, and flagISNV applies it after the per-sample thresholds.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'ConcordanceRule'
show(object)

Arguments

object

A ConcordanceRule object.

Value

An object of class ConcordanceRule. Objects are created with the constructor ConcordanceRule; the show method prints the two settings and returns NULL invisibly.

Details

Replicates are the samples that share a value of the replicate_group column of colData. Every pair of replicates in a group is compared, and a site that fails for any pair is flagged in every sample of the group. A call is a non-missing altFreq, taken before any threshold is applied, so the rule flags what flagReplicateDiscordance flags with the same two settings. Replicate intersection, which keeps only the calls made in both replicates, is ConcordanceRule(freqTolerance = Inf). Frequencies lie in [0, 1], so no two differ by more than 1: a rule with freqTolerance of 1 or more, Inf included, and requireBothDetected = FALSE would flag nothing and is refused.

Slots

freqTolerance

Numeric scalar. The largest difference in altFreq allowed between two replicates that both made the call (default: 0.05); a difference equal to it, to within rounding error, passes. Inf compares no frequencies.

requireBothDetected

Logical scalar. If TRUE (default), a site called in one replicate of a pair but not in the other fails.

See also

ConcordanceRule for the constructor, ISNVFilter and flagISNV for applying it, flagReplicateDiscordance for the same check on its own.

Examples

# Frequencies within 5 points, and called in both replicates
ConcordanceRule()
#> ConcordanceRule object
#>   freqTolerance:       0.05 
#>   requireBothDetected: TRUE 

# Replicate intersection only
ConcordanceRule(freqTolerance = Inf)
#> ConcordanceRule object
#>   freqTolerance:       Inf 
#>   requireBothDetected: TRUE
